extracted.intended_audience: manufacturers, owners/operators of stationary sources (internal combustion engines, combustion turbines, sewage sludge incinerators, crude oil and natural gas facilities), and state/local/Tribal agencies implementing NSPS (40 CFR Part 60)
extracted.subtask_description: Identify and follow the requirements in 40 CFR Part 60 (New Source Performance Standards) subparts covering stationary internal combustion engines, combustion turbines, sewage sludge incineration units, and crude oil and natural gas facilities — including applicability, emission limits, monitoring, testing, reporting, recordkeeping, operator training, and state plan/model rule provisions.
